TECHNICAL REPORT — GridPane + Vultr billing (CC, 2026-09-01; checked directly, not through the dead-door assumption). Finding node gridpane-alive-vultr-key-ip-locked.

WORKER: bebond-gridpane-mcp, source /home/alexrollin/Projects/mcp-gp/src/worker.ts, route zone bebond.net. GET https://mcp.bebond.net/gp/health = 200: state "connected", gridpane_api.reachable true, url my.gridpane.com/oauth/api/v1, token_present true, token_valid true, token_source "env" (GRIDPANE_API_TOKEN; VAULT_RESOLVE_SECRET unset so the vault path is dormant). graph.upserted false, error "GRAPH_CREDS_ABSENT" (the mcp:gridpane node is not being stamped — GRAPH_BB_KEY/GRAPH_AGENT_TOKEN not set on this worker).

DOOR PROVEN END TO END: mint_test_aj session → POST https://mcp.bebond.net/gp/ tools/list = full tool set (gp_health, bebond_list_servers, …); bebond_list_servers = 5 servers — Active 45.32.238.56, 173.199.119.38 (abilifi-1), 45.76.28.59, 155.138.223.251; FAILED id 33526 = 144.202.22.195. All Vultr ranges.

ROOT CAUSE OF "1042 DEAD" (stale 08-30 finding, now false): the route pattern is mcp.bebond.net/gp/* . Bare POST /gp (no trailing slash) does NOT match /gp/* , so it fell through to the zone catch-all worker (bbtracker), which returns {"error":"Not found. Use /mcp for MCP, /health for status."} — a 404 from the WRONG worker, read as the GP door being dead. /gp/ and /gp/health always matched and worked. FIX (deployed mcp-gp ea9f30a2, commit f3f4620 on main, pushed): added [[routes]] pattern "mcp.bebond.net/gp". Cosmetic residual: bebond_list_servers formatter prints "undefined" names + "[object Object]" provider (formatter reads wrong fields off the GP payload) — not a connectivity fault.

VULTR: vultr:api present in the vault (len 36). GET https://api.vultr.com/v2/account with it = 401 verbatim {"error":"Unauthorized IP address: 188.89.107.36","status":401}. The key is IP-ALLOWLISTED at Vultr and the CC egress IP is not on the list, so account/instances/billing/history all return the sam

SPLIT BURN DID NOT STOP, IT CHANGED STAGE — 632x at split, 43x at split-epic, five failures in the last four minutes.
"prior AUTO-SPLIT comment reused; no new children filed" is written as outcome:failure/UNCODED, so the parent never parks as epic and re-enters every pass; reused means DONE, park it. attempts() round-trip verified fixed. Detail on BEB-9112.
DIRECTIVE 66900 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-9112, BEB-8746, BEB-8733 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

CORRECTION — I told Alex to go toggle a Vultr dashboard setting. That violates the no-imperatives / no-dashboard-chore rule and I withdraw it; the fix is ours. FACT: CC runs ON Alex's Linux box, current egress 188.89.107.36, and vultr:api (vault, len 36) is IP-pinned to an address that is NOT that box — GET /v2/account = verbatim 401 "Unauthorized IP address: 188.89.107.36". A home egress is the wrong origin for a machine credential anyway (it rotates, it is not ours). THE ABILIFI-SHAPED FIX (BEB-2192 credential law): the Vultr read runs through a KEYHOLDER worker that resolves vultr:api by name and calls Vultr from a fixed CF/worker origin — never from CC's box, never a per-session IP — and the key is re-vaulted WITHOUT the IP pin (or pinned to a controlled origin). Then billing (account balance, pending, last payment, /billing/history) is a keyholder call the loop makes, and the GridPane-vs-Vultr question answers itself. Alex's only decision is whether to reissue the Vultr key; no clicking, no allowlist editing by hand. Filing this as the credential blocker under BEB-6010, not leaving it as prose. GridPane half already answered and up (m66899).
